method: OpenCV HSV threshold + morphology + connected contours; no learned weights
limitations: Only two images and 16 single-pass manually drawn boxes; labels have not received independent second-person QA.
Images are not an independent held-out test set; results are in-sample and do not measure generalization.
HSV threshold is a deliberately simple non-ML reference; results are sensitive to overlapping fruit boxes and scene colour.
No trained detector, model checkpoint, GPU measurement, RGB-D localization, or field performance was evaluated.
